ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: new fields
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: A hundred and fifty plants sown by the colony's people while the project runs: new fields laid out and planted, old ones sown again. Only for a colony where someone grows.

plain.li: We grow just enough to get by. I'd like to grow enough that a bad season doesn't scare us.
A hundred and fifty plants in the ground, new fields and old. Then we'll see what the land can really do.
[spring] The ground is soft and the days are getting long. This is the time to sow.
[lowmood] Nothing cheers people up like green rows coming up where there was only dirt.
[tribal] My people say the land gives back what you put into it. Let's put a lot into it.
[spacer] We have the seed and we have the soil. Let's plant as if we mean to stay.

warm.li: I want full fields, so nobody here ever has to go hungry.

blunt.li: More fields. More planting. More food.

cheerful.li: I can already picture it: rows and rows, as far as the fence.

gloomy.li: One bad harvest and we're in trouble. More fields would give us room to fail.

cold.li: More land under crops means more food per day of work in the long run.

plain.li: A hundred and fifty plants in the ground. The fields are bigger than they've ever been.

warm.li: Everyone helped with the sowing. I'm proud of every row.

cheerful.li: New fields everywhere I look. I can't wait for the harvest.

gloomy.li: The fields are sown. Now it's up to the weather.

cold.li: The sowing is done. The colony's fields are larger now.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.dayLabel: the day the new fields were sown

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the makers' month
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Forty things made by hand by the colony's people while the project runs: tools, clothes, weapons, whatever the benches can turn out. Only for a colony where someone crafts.

plain.li: Half of what we use was taken off raiders or bought from traders. I'd like us to make our own.
Forty things made at our own benches in a month. It would change what we think we can do.
[lowmood] People feel better when they can point at something and say they made it.
[tribal] A people that makes its own tools owes nothing to anyone. Let's be that people.
[spacer] The benches can make more than we ask of them. Let's find out how much more.

warm.li: I'd like every one of us to own something made here, by someone they know.

blunt.li: Forty things. Our benches. One month.

cheerful.li: A whole month of making things! I've got a list as long as my arm.

gloomy.li: If the traders stopped coming, could we look after ourselves? Let's make sure we could.

cold.li: Making our own goods costs less than buying them and teaches the makers.

plain.li: Forty things made at our own benches. Look around: half of what you see, we made.

warm.li: Everyone's wearing or carrying something made here now. I love that.

cheerful.li: Forty! My hands may never forgive me.

gloomy.li: We can look after ourselves now, mostly. That's worth something.

cold.li: Forty goods made. The colony relies less on traders now.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.dayLabel: the end of the makers' month

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a good old age
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Every one of the colony's elders sleeping in a bedroom of their own, or shared with their partner, that is at least decent (impressiveness 30). A better bed, a floor, a light, some art and a little more space all help. Proposed while one of the elders goes without.

plain.li: Our old ones built this place, and some of them sleep in the worst rooms in it. That isn't right.
I'd like every one of our elders to have a decent room to grow old in. They've earned it.
[winter] The cold gets into old bones. Our elders should have proper rooms before it does.
[lowmood] When the old are well looked after, everyone sleeps easier. We all get old, if we're lucky.
[tribal] My people give the warmest place by the fire to the eldest. Let's give ours a room worth having.

warm.li: They looked after us. Now we look after them.

blunt.li: The old ones need proper rooms. Build them.

cheerful.li: Let's make the elders' rooms so nice the rest of us get jealous.

gloomy.li: None of us knows how many winters the old ones have left. Let's make them comfortable ones.

cold.li: The elders hold what the colony knows. Their comfort is worth the timber.

plain.li: Every one of our elders has a decent room now. I walked past each door tonight just to see.

warm.li: Our old ones are comfortable at last. They deserve every bit of it.

cheerful.li: The elders' rooms are the best in the colony. Exactly as it should be.

gloomy.li: They have good rooms now. I hope they have them for a long time.

cold.li: The elders are well housed. That was owed to them.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.dayLabel: the day the elders had good rooms

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the neighbours' call
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Answer a call for help from the colony's neighbours: one of the colony's people sent when word comes that a people nearby needs it. Proposed only while such a call is running, with world events on.

plain.li: Our neighbours are asking for help. One day it'll be us asking. Let's answer.
Word has come that the people nearby are in trouble. I'd like us to send someone.
[lowmood] We spend all our time worrying about ourselves. Helping someone else would do us good.
[tribal] My people never turned away a neighbour who came asking. Neither should we.
[spacer] Out here, the nearest help is whoever lives over the hill. Right now that's us.

warm.li: If we were the ones in trouble, I'd want someone to come. Let's be the ones who come.

cheerful.li: A chance to be the good neighbours for once. Let's take it.

gloomy.li: If we turn our backs now, nobody will answer when we call.

cold.li: Help given now is help we can ask for later. It is a sound use of a few days.

plain.li: We answered the neighbours' call. They'll remember who came.

warm.li: We helped them when they needed it. That's what neighbours are for.

cheerful.li: We were the good neighbours. I knew we had it in us.

gloomy.li: We helped this time. I hope someone helps us when it's our turn.

cold.li: The call was answered. The colony's word is worth more for it.

li.label: a toast to the ones who went

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.dayLabel: the day the colony answered its neighbours
